options.reason: The table is one row per tumour with a single binary outcome column (label: 47 vs 68), which the brief identifies as progesterone-receptor status, and ~11k log-scale protein abundance features of one homogeneous kind. This is a two-class classification problem predicting PR status from the proteome, evaluated with cross-validation on the training rows, so the workflow default metric is kept and no numeric override applies.
